Team — quick pricing note. The ladder in Healthyn's redline appears to apply discounts retroactively to the whole month once thresholds are met; per our standard we only apply the tiered rate prospectively for the remainder of the month. Two possible paths:

A) Accept their retroactive language — finance wants a 6% effective rate increase to offset risk.
B) Counter-proposal: prospective tiering + a one-time onboarding credit to keep initial NRR neutral.

If Healthyn is sensitive to list-rate movement, option B is cleaner commercially. I'll draft both numbers and a short rationale for Legal.

-karthik
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Jordan / team / Maria — attaching Legal's annotated counter to the redline. High-level:
- We cannot accept the retroactive discounting (karthik's point). Proposed language enforces prospective tiers and a clarified definition of "throughput" for billing (tokens vs. inference-requests).

- Liability: we preserved Redwood's existing cap but added explicit operational SLA carve-outs for third-party infra (marketplaces / cloud provider outages).
